items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: one of the jobs that I had in the earliest, was with Willie 'the Lion' Smith when he added me to his duo to make a trio.

ctx.x: I do remember very well that Count Basie was playing at a place where he just played with a drummer. And he was very, very kind to me. I used to go in and sit in with him. I used to go in and sit in with Willie "the Lion" Smith, who also played with just a piano and a drummer.

And then one of the jobs that I had in the earliest, was with Willie "the Lion" Smith when he added me to his duo to make a trio. Piano, drums and saxophone. And I must say, I certainly learned a lot from him.

items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: But you didn't have that kind of relationship with him that you had with Willie the Lion, though? Unfortunately, I did not.
